    <p class="course-toc-meta">Topic: Relativistic quantum mechanics</p>
  </header>

::: {.qft-exam-body}
1.  Let the state of a free electron at $t=0$ be given by $$\psi(0,\boldsymbol{x}) = \frac{1}{(2\pi d^2)^{3/4}}e^{-\frac{\boldsymbol{x}^2}{4d^2}}
        \begin{pmatrix}
             1 \\
             0 \\
             0 \\
             0
        \end{pmatrix}.$$ Find $\psi(t,\boldsymbol{x})$ for $t>0$.

2.  Obtain an analytic expression for the mean current as an integral over the 3-momentum: $$\boldsymbol{J}=\int d^3x \psi^\dagger(x)\,\boldsymbol{\alpha}\,\psi(x).$$

3.  Compute this integral and make an animation of $\boldsymbol{J}(t)$.

4.  Does the tremor of the current last forever?

5.  Compute the pressure $P$ of the field and make an animation of $P(t)$.

6.  Explain the results.

:::
